title: Fixed development dependency installation quoting
description: GitHub Actions run 31561808679 failed for Emacs 29.4 and 30.2 because Makefile line continuations were passed literally inside single-quoted Lisp --eval arguments.
close_reason: Kept each Emacs Lisp --eval form on one physical Make recipe line so shell continuation backslashes were not passed as Lisp input; verified dependency installation and all quality checks.

title: Required br and bv resolution through exec-path
description: Make the Emacs package resolve configured br and bv executable names only through exec-path, reject path-valued configuration, and align README customization guidance with that contract.
close_reason: Required bare br and bv command names, resolved them through Emacs exec-path for synchronous, asynchronous, and version-check execution, rejected path-valued configuration, updated documentation, and added regression coverage.

title: Renamed the Emacs package to beads
description: Rename the Emacs package, feature, public commands, customization variables, modules, tests, installation path, and documentation from bv to beads. Keep only M-x bv as a convenient alias for the primary M-x beads command. Keep references to the external bv executable unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Requiring beads exposes a consistently beads-prefixed API; M-x beads is primary and M-x bv is its alias; package metadata and installation use beads; no legacy bv-prefixed Emacs API remains; full quality and isolated install checks pass.
close_reason: Renamed the package, feature, modules, symbols, customization, tests, documentation, autoloads, and install path to beads; retained only M-x bv as a short alias; verified source and isolated installed-package behavior.

title: Kept list help popup aligned with direct bindings
description: Audit the package-owned Beads list bindings against the question-mark popup. Add missing help entries, including refresh, show-at-point, the lowercase Open alias, and label filtering, with regression coverage that fails when a direct binding is absent from the popup.
close_reason: Added context-sensitive help popups for list, issue-detail, and analysis buffers with exhaustive direct-binding regression tests.

title: Built an Emacs interface for br and bv
description:
## Goal

Deliver an Emacs 29+ package for browsing, triaging, creating, updating, and
inspecting Beads issues through the documented `br` and `bv` structured
interfaces.

## Success Criteria

- Provide discoverable list, detail, triage, planning, mutation, and diagnostic
  commands.
- Invoke `br` and `bv` through safe argument lists and tolerate additive JSON
  fields.
- Pass byte compilation, Checkdoc, package-lint, ERT, live smoke, Markdown, and
  whitespace checks.
- Include package metadata, installation instructions, architecture notes, and
  contribution guidance.
acceptance_criteria: The package provides a discoverable interactive UI, safe subprocess integration, automated ERT coverage, package metadata, documentation, and passing quality gates.
close_reason: Delivered and validated the Emacs 29+ br and bv interface

title: Defined the Emacs package architecture
description: Define the public commands, data model, subprocess boundary, buffers, customization points, and Emacs 29 compatibility contract.
acceptance_criteria: A written implementation contract covers list, detail, triage, mutation, refresh, error handling, and package structure.

comments.author: dajobe
comments.text: Architecture contract recorded in docs/architecture.md after reviewing local br 0.2.22 and bv 0.19.0 machine-readable command surfaces.

title: Implemented structured br and bv process integration
description: Implement safe argv-based asynchronous or synchronous command execution, JSON decoding, workspace discovery, version checks, and actionable errors.
acceptance_criteria: Emacs invokes br and bv without a shell, parses documented JSON envelopes, preserves stderr, and exposes reusable internal APIs.
close_reason: Implemented and verified structured process integration

title: Implemented the interactive Beads major mode
description: Build an Emacs 29+ tabulated issue browser and detail workflow with refresh, filtering, triage, navigation, and guarded mutations.
acceptance_criteria: Users can open a repository, browse and inspect issues, invoke triage, create and update issues, and discover commands through menus and key bindings.
close_reason: Implemented and live-validated the interactive Emacs interface

title: Added automated tests and fixtures
description: Add ERT tests for JSON normalization, command construction, rendering, workspace behavior, mutation prompts, and failures without requiring live Beads binaries.
acceptance_criteria: Focused and full test commands pass on Emacs 29+, including byte compilation and regression coverage for subprocess boundaries.
close_reason: Added and passed 48 ERT regression tests

title: Added package documentation and quality automation
description: Add README usage, installation, customization, contribution notes, package metadata, Make targets, and lint or compilation automation.
acceptance_criteria: A new user can install and use the package from the README, and documented Make targets run all supported checks.
close_reason: Added and validated package documentation and quality automation

title: Added automatic refresh for external Beads changes
description:
## Goal

Refresh visible Beads UI buffers when another process changes the workspace
JSONL export.

## Success Criteria

- List, issue detail, and analysis buffers watch `issues.jsonl` or legacy
  `beads.jsonl`, falling back to the data directory before the file exists.
- File writes and atomic replacements schedule one debounced refresh for visible
  buffers.
- Replaced files are watched again after the notification backend finishes its
  callback.
- Watchers and timers are removed when buffers die or change workspace.
- Unsupported file-notification environments retain manual refresh behavior.
- Focused and full ERT suites pass.
acceptance_criteria: Visible Beads UI buffers refresh after external JSONL changes without leaking watchers or timers.
close_reason: Added debounced visible-buffer refresh, replacement-safe file watches, cleanup, regression tests, and a live macOS kqueue smoke test.

title: Clarified the installed beads package directory
description: Keep the repository and project identity as beads-emacs while making the local Emacs installation path explicitly ~/.emacs.d/site-lisp/beads. Add a ready-to-copy use-package example for that installed directory and avoid pointing installed users at the source checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Repository metadata remains beads-emacs; make install targets site-lisp/beads; README shows the installed beads load-path explicitly; Markdown formatting and full quality gates pass.
close_reason: Documented the repository as beads-emacs and the installed Emacs package directory, feature, API, and customization surface as beads.

title: Aligned direct list filter shortcuts with menu
description: Make the main Beads list honor the popup shortcuts: O filters open issues, X filters closed issues, and c creates an issue. Keep o as a convenient Open alias and cover the direct keymap contract with ERT tests.
close_reason: Aligned the direct Beads list shortcuts with the popup and added regression coverage.

title: Added issue ID completion to bv-show
description:
## Goal

Make interactive `bv-show` selection complete over issue IDs and titles from the
active workspace.

## Success Criteria

- `M-x bv-show` lists every issue returned by `br list --all --json`.
- Completion displays both the issue ID and title while returning only the ID.
- Programmatic `bv-show` calls continue accepting an explicit ID and workspace.
- Focused and full ERT suites pass.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive bv-show completes issue IDs and titles without changing programmatic calls.
close_reason: Added required issue ID and title completion to interactive bv-show selection with regression coverage.

title: Improved descriptive text wrapping in bv-show
description:
## Goal

Make long descriptive text in `bv-show` readable at the current window width
without modifying stored issue content.

## Success Criteria

- Detail buffers wrap at word boundaries instead of truncating or splitting
  normal prose awkwardly.
- Navigation follows visual lines in the detail buffer.
- Tabulated issue lists retain their existing layout.
- Focused and full ERT suites pass.
acceptance_criteria: bv-show wraps prose at word boundaries without changing list layout or stored content.
close_reason: Enabled visual word wrapping in issue detail buffers and verified the mode settings.

title: Improved responsive issue list rows
description:
## Goal

Make Beads list rows emphasize the same information hierarchy as the full-width
`bv` list while remaining readable in an Emacs window.

## Success Criteria

- Each row shows a recognizable type icon, priority, compact state, issue ID,
  and the beginning of the title.
- Relative age is based on the issue creation time and remains anchored at the
  right edge.
- Long titles are truncated to preserve the age and important leading fields.
- Existing issue selection, navigation, view switching, faces, and priority
  sorting continue to work.
- Relative-time boundaries, icons, compact states, layout, and narrow windows
  have ERT coverage.
- Documentation and the full quality suite pass.
acceptance_criteria: Issue lists show type, priority, compact state, ID, title, and right-aligned relative age without rigid wide columns.
close_reason: Added responsive type, priority, compact status, ID, title, and right-aligned creation-age rows with resize handling and live rendering verification.

title: Improved in-place list filtering
description:
## Goal

Make Beads list views behave like the `bv` TUI: switching common views filters
the current list buffer.

## Success Criteria

- `a`, `r`, and `b` switch the current Beads list between All, Ready, and
  Blocked without opening another buffer.
- Open and Closed views are available with `o` and `c`, matching `bv`.
- `l` filters by a label selected with completion, and `/` searches in place.
- Direct commands invoked outside a list still open an appropriate list buffer.
- Switching views updates the existing buffer name, header, command arguments,
  and selection consistently.
- Documentation and ERT regression coverage are updated and all checks pass.
acceptance_criteria: Beads list view and filter commands reuse the current buffer and expose the main bv filter dimensions.
close_reason: Added in-place All, Open, Closed, Ready, Blocked, label, and search filtering with live and ERT verification.
